what.text: This page follows refugees from Liberia living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 996 Liberian refugees in the United States, 19.5% of all refugees from Liberia.
Côte d'Ivoire hosts the most Liberian refugees, followed by the United States, Ghana and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Liberia in 1989 and 1990, with the NPFL, and from 2000 to 2003, with LURD and MODEL.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2004 to 2006, come just after the second period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 18 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 33992, at the end of 2006, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
